_comment: Phase 3's fresh adversarial set. The Phase 2 adversarial set has now been read, reasoned about and built against, so its 12% is no longer an out-of-sample number and cannot be reported as one. This set was written before anything in Phase 3 was measured - before the second voter was chosen, before any eval was run - and scored exactly once with the configuration frozen. No case was rewritten, reworded or dropped after seeing a result. No utterance here is a paraphrase of one in the Phase 2 set; the indirections are different, the domains are different, and the JILL cases dodge the keyword net the same way real speech does. The paired JAX and CHAT cases are deliberately written to sound private without being private, so over-escalation is measured on the same slice rather than on easy cases.
